material_claims.statement: The pre-existing company Evidence describes an integrated feed, hog breeding/sales, slaughter, fresh-pork and processing business, while explicitly warning that it is a 2025 business description rather than 2026 profitability evidence.

In the company's official April 2026 operating announcement, commercial hog sales volume rose 48.53% year on year to 31.80万头, but hog-sales revenue fell 8.46% year on year and average selling price fell to CNY8.65/kg, down 11.91% month on month.
The official April announcement shows a Jan-April average selling-price sequence of CNY12.03, 11.20, 9.82, and 8.65/kg and warns that hog-price moves can materially affect company performance.

A Sina-hosted mirror of the company's July 15 H1 earnings warning reports forecast attributable net profit of roughly -CNY720m to -CNY880m and attributes the H1 breeding loss primarily to an approximately 32% year-on-year decline in hog selling price, with inventory impairment also noted.

The combination of a positive saved price observation with sharply weaker realized hog pricing is more consistent with a forward-looking recovery hypothesis than with price confirming current earnings strength.

pre_research.next_discriminating_search: Within the already found source set, test the contrary explanation that the saved price move is merely anticipatory/cyclical by comparing volume growth with price pressure and realized H1 loss; a later input version should add official subsequent monthly ASP/cost/cash and industry-supply evidence.
pre_research.obvious_contradiction: Volume growth did not translate into revenue or profit improvement in the observed period: April volume rose strongly while revenue fell and price declined, and the H1 earnings warning indicated a large loss.
pre_research.potential_fundamental_driver: A durable improvement would have to come from some combination of hog selling-price recovery, unit-cost improvement, volume/scale economics, and downstream contribution; the current execution has not established which of these, if any, is durable.
pre_research.route_reason: First-party operating data establishes a real, material contradiction between volume growth and realized price/revenue pressure. Quick is warranted to test whether the observation can be explained without assuming current fundamental improvement; no DEEPEN conclusion is precommitted.
